CustomField.description: Set to true when the SES Configuration Set attached to sends is confirmed to exist in the connected AWS account — either auto-provisioned by AmazonSESWebhookManager.createWebhook() or a manually entered name that passed existence validation. When false, AmazonSESRestExplorer.getConfirmedConfigurationSetName() returns null so a send omits ConfigurationSetName rather than attach a name that may not exist in SES.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When unchecked, outbound sends omit ConfigurationSetName because the configured (or fallback) name has not been confirmed to exist in SES.
CustomField.label: Configuration Set Confirmed
